mapper.insert: INSERT INTO answer ( article_id, user_id, form_id, content, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{articleId}, #{userId}, #{formId}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET status = 'ANSWERED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.answer_id as answerId, a.article_id as articleId, a.user_id as userId, a.form_id as form_id, a.content, a.created_at as createdAt, a.updated_at as updatedAt, u.name as admin_name, f.form_name FROM answer a LEFT JOIN site_user u ON a.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN forms f ON a.form_id = f.form_id WHERE a.article_id = #{articleId} ORDER BY a.created_at ASC
